Non-conformance Report NC-2024-087
To: J. Park, Quality Assurance Lead, Korean Defense Systems Inc.
Subject: Dimensional Deviation in Lot K9000-2345

Dear J. Park,

During final inspection on April 5, 2024, part DR-7742-009 from Lot K9000-2345 exhibited a 0.15mm deviation in diameter tolerance, exceeding the AS9100 specification. This issue was traced to the CNC milling step on machine #3. Corrective action includes recalibration and retraining of operator Lee Minho. A full re-inspection is scheduled for April 8, 2024. The total cost of rework and delay is estimated at $18,450. Please confirm acceptance of this report by April 10, 2024.

Best regards,

Y. Kim
Quality Control Manager
+82-2-555-0198
y.kim@kdsi.co.kr
